title: Monk Plane of Sky Tests
wikitext:
[[File:Holwin.png|right|200px|thumb|]] '''Note:''' Most quests in the Plane of Sky require two items. One of those items will be a wind rune and can be found on any mob as a random drop in the Plane of Sky. The second item you need is from an island boss, they are rare drops. Some quests require a third ''Efreeti'' weapon which is also attained from island bosses in the Plane of Sky. '''To reach the quest room find the ('''[[Key Master]]''') near where you zoned in on island 1 and purchase an [[Efreeti's Key]]. It is free and looks like a [[Jade]]. After you have the key left click on the teleportation pad at the North point of the island, around [[Plane of Sky|1600, 520]] .''' You only need to buy the key one time and it will be saved to your character. '''Find''' '''Holwin and Hail him. He will tell you about the quests he has to offer. Reading his dialogue is optional and you can simply hand him your quest items.''' == Checklist == Bold item names indicate No Drop items. {{CheckboxList}}

==Quest Start== Talk to Holwin in the [[Plane of Sky]]. You say, 'Hail, Holwin' :''Holwin says, 'Peace to you, Gand. I see that you have come far along the path of tranquility and enlightenment. Do you wish to [test] yourself further, and perhaps complete the path you started on so long ago?' '' You say, 'I wish to test myself further and complete the path of tranquility and enlightenment' :''Holwin says 'Do you wish to follow the path of Ton Po or Wu? The path of Ton Po, known for his uncanny abilities, consists of three trials. [Strength], [sight], and [speed]. The path of Wu, known for his introspection, has three further trials. [Tears], [fists], and [tranquility]. Now, choose.'' == Monk Test of Strength == You say, 'Strength' Holwin says, 'So be it, the test of strength you shall have. Bring to me some silken strands and a wind rune caza. The task will not be easy, but it should serve as an adequate test of strength, for one of your abilities.' '''Reward:''' {{:Back Straps of Mastery}} {| class="eoTable3" ! The mind will allow you to see that which is usually invisible. Bring me a cracked leather eyepatch and a wind rune geza and I will assist you in seeing what should not be seen.' '''Reward:''' {{:Ton Po's Eye Patch}} {| class="eoTable3" ! Every monk must be swift if he is to best his opponent. Speed in both mind and body is essential in many facets of life. Return to me some dove slippers and a wind rune jaka and I shall aid your speed of mind.' '''Reward:''' {{:Sandals of Alacrity}} {| class="eoTable3" ! Bring me a silken wrap and a wind rune beza. I will teach you the way.' '''Reward:''' {{:Ton Po's Shoulder Wraps}} {| class="eoTable3" ! Item || Who || Where |- | [[Wind Rune Beza]] || random drop || Plane of Sky |- | [[Silken Wrap]] || [[Bazzt Zzzt]] || Island 6 |} == Monk Test of Fists == You say, 'fists' Holwin says, 'A monk must know when to use his or her fists, and when to use the mind. In this endeavor, you must decide which you shall use. Return to me, once you have found them, a pair of brass knuckles, nebulous sapphire and a wind rune neza.'
